ترتشفن (form VIII)
# تَرْتَشِفْنَ (tartašifna) /tar.ta.ʃif.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
# تُرْتَشَفْنَ (turtašafna) /tur.ta.ʃaf.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
